t: This Magnusson 2.69m aluminium loft ladder provides a robust and reliable solution for accessing loft spaces in residential and commercial properties. Ideal for builders, electricians, and general tradespeople requiring safe and efficient attic entry, this 2-section ladder is constructed from durable aluminium for long-lasting performance. It features non-slip feet and D-shaped rungs for enhanced grip and comfort during ascent and descent, supporting a maximum static vertical load of 150kg. All necessary fixings and fittings are supplied for straightforward installation, ensuring a secure setup for regular use.
